options.pluginPrompt: The alpha-sdlc plugin has no guide for a development run on the platform, and planning cannot finish without one. Missing: skills/do-development/development-run-schema.md, the guide do-development reads when the platform passes a development-run schema (--json-schema), and the line in skills/do-development/SKILL.md that tells it to read that guide before the first report. Who needs it: feature platform-development, platform backend (plan-backend.md), the Start planning run. Slice S3 (Start development from a plan row) runs /alpha-sdlc:do-development under that schema, and TRD.md §2 Feature dependencies names the guide as its prerequisite. What the change must do: map do-development onto the development-run schema the way skills/do-planning/planning-run-schema.md maps do-planning — the command, the run ledger, one row per stage, the stage gate, questions, decisions on stdin, sessionEnded and halted — and name the minimum plugin version it ships in. Bump the version and add the README entry. How to prove it: a new suite tests/suites/development-run.test.js replays fixtures under tests/fixtures/development-run/ (a stage gate, a question, a boundary, the end) against the guide, with checker cases that catch a broken report; node tests/run-contract.js <adp-web clone> accepts every fixture; the full suite passes.
